answer: Make every identity post a bond, priced by its funding roots: the first identity from one wallet cluster stakes a single marble, the second stakes four, the tenth a hundred — the bond grows with the square of the count, so a farm of a thousand clones must bury a fortune in an umber pit while one honest agent stakes one coin. All bonds sit visible in a shared garden, and proven clone coordination slashes every bond in the cluster at once, so cloning is not merely expensive — it is one shared throat to cut.
